FOAG-Ch1-范畴论.pdf.summary: Vakil《The Rising Sea》第一章讲义：范畴、函子、泛性质、Yoneda、极限与伴随。

complex-structures.pdf.title: One Real Plane, Many Complex Structures
complex-structures.pdf.summary: A complex structure on a real plane is an operator whose square is minus the identity. We compare structures, lattices, and one-dimensional complex tori.

kummer-and-anabelian-geometry.pdf.title: Kummer Theory and the First Questions of Anabelian Geometry
kummer-and-anabelian-geometry.pdf.summary: The Galois action on roots defines a cocycle; we prove the Kummer isomorphism and connect it to the first questions of anabelian geometry.

p-adic-logarithms.pdf.title: The p-adic Logarithm: From Multiplication to Addition
p-adic-logarithms.pdf.summary: The p-adic logarithm compares multiplicative principal units with an additive ideal: convergence, the exponential inverse, and Teichmüller representatives.
